signature_features: Tall needle-nose cast turret with M19 commander cupola mounting the M85 .50 cal
105 mm M68 rifled gun with thermal sleeve and bore evacuator; smoke grenade launchers on turret sides (A3)
Wind sensor mast on turret rear roof and TTS thermal sight housing on A3 TTS (variant difference vs M60A1)
Six road wheels and three return rollers per side, no side skirts, large front idler and rear sprocket
Rear deck with louvred grille doors and big rear exhaust grilles for the AVDS-1790 diesel; turret bustle rack with stowage
